articles.summary: Despite changing technology and the rise of streaming, industry leaders at DEG's EnTech Fest said movie theaters remain essential. National CineMedia’s Tom Lesinski noted cinema has outlasted formats like DVD, continuing to drive value. Lionsgate execs agreed theatrical releases are key to consumer perception and streaming success. While box office numbers haven’t fully recovered, the theatrical window has stabilized and remains a vital part of the entertainment business.
articles.title: Executives Tout Importance of Legacy Theatrical Business at DEG EnTech Confab

articles.summary: iSpot and National CineMedia have partnered to launch the first scaled measurement of cinema ads, enabling brands to track performance alongside TV, digital, and streaming. The integration provides real-time insights, including reach, frequency, and sales impact—positioning cinema as a measurable, outcomes-driven media channel.
articles.title: iSpot and National CineMedia Partner to Provide First-of-its-Kind Cinema Measurement at Scale

articles.summary: National CineMedia is partnering with Operative to modernize its ad-sales operations using AI-powered cloud tools. The collaboration will enhance forecasting, speed up proposal workflows, and improve campaign performance across NCM’s nationwide cinema network.
articles.title: National CineMedia Partners with Operative’s Suite of AI-Based Cloud Solutions

articles.summary: NCM and iSpot announced in June that they’re expanding their partnership to provide the first-ever scaled, third-party measurement of in-theater ads, specifically those that run during trailers before a movie begins. For the first time, NCM will integrate its household-level exposure data with iSpot’s unified cross-platform and outcomes-based measurement solutions.
articles.title: iSpot and NCM Partner to Track Theater Ad Performance

articles.summary: A strong Memorial Day Weekend box office has analysts and marketers hoping for pre-pandemic levels of movie magic.
articles.title: Are movies so back?

articles.summary: National CineMedia, the largest cinema advertising platform in the US, and cross‑platform TV ad measurement company iSpot, have announced the companies are deepening their partnership – with independent, in‑cinema measurement of advertisements that appear in the trailers before movies begin. The deal marks NCM’s first integration of advertising information with a third‑party measurement provider…
articles.title: iSpot, NCM partnership

articles.summary: National CineMedia partners with Vistar Media to expand programmatic access to cinema ad inventory, offering brands an efficient, data-driven way to reach engaged moviegoers on the big screen through Vistar’s SSP.
articles.title: National CineMedia Expands Programmatic Inventory Through New Partnership with Vistar Media
